boundary_fill.title: Region fill
boundary_fill.help: Pick an enclosed region, inspect its boundaries, then preview a calibrated area.
boundary_fill.scope: Uses page content only. Annotations are excluded. A gap can connect unrelated spaces; inspect every boundary and deduction.
boundary_fill.draw_help: Click inside the region. To bridge a gap, choose Close a gap and drag between its edges. Pan moves the image; Fit restores the whole page.
boundary_fill.calibration_help: Automatic uses saved scales and refuses ambiguous regions. Page scale is an explicit override. Calibrate the page in Measurements if no scale is available.
boundary_fill.incomplete: This region is incomplete or unsafe to accept. Adjust the seed, threshold or manual closures and try again. No area can be created from a stopped result.
boundary_fill.outline_help: Blue outlines show the outer boundary; red outlines show excluded islands. Raster boundaries depend on resolution and the chosen threshold.
boundary_fill.reviewed: I reviewed the boundary, deductions and scale
boundary_fill.read_only: This document cannot receive area measurements. You can still inspect permitted page content.
boundary_fill.cancelled: Region fill cancelled — no area created
boundary_fill.leaked: The region reaches the page edge. Close the intended boundary or choose another region.
boundary_fill.seed_blocked: The selected point lies on a boundary. Pick a point inside the open region.
boundary_fill.limit: Processing limit reached. Try a lower resolution or a smaller enclosed region.
boundary_fill.topology: The boundary has ambiguous contacts. Adjust the threshold or manual closures and inspect again.
boundary_fill.complexity: This boundary is too complex to preserve accurately. Try a lower resolution or trace a measured area manually.
visual_search.title: Find symbols
visual_search.help: Select a symbol, search locally, then review matches before creating counts.
visual_search.scope: Searches page content at the same size. Existing annotations and form widgets are excluded.
visual_search.select_help: Drag a tight rectangle around one symbol. Enter pages such as 1,3-5 (up to 16 pages).
visual_search.complete: Search complete for the selected pages and settings
visual_search.partial: This search is incomplete. Selected matches can be counted, but they are not a complete inventory.
visual_search.similarity_help: Similarity is an image comparison score, not recognition accuracy. Preview and select only the matches you accept.
visual_search.existing_counts: Existing counts remain. Check previews for objects already counted; duplicates are not removed automatically.
visual_search.read_only: This document cannot receive count markers. You can still inspect permitted search results.
visual_search.bad_pages: Enter up to 16 valid pages or ranges, such as 1,3-5.

zones.help: Define named rectangles on this page. Location uses the whole annotation rectangle; crossing or overlapping regions remain unresolved.
zones.stale: The plan or page geometry changed. Historical zones cannot assign current annotations.
zones.reset_stale: I reviewed the historical bounds and explicitly replace these zones
zones.read_only: This document does not permit zone edits.

zones.draw: Draw its rectangle on the page

zones.reviewed: I reviewed the bounds, hierarchy and assignments
zones.incomplete: Some locations are unresolved. A room-filtered total is unavailable until they are resolved.

register.count_help: Click the centre of each item on the plan. Each marker counts as one. Use Select annotation to move or delete markers; Undo restores changes.
register.help: Search all fields, including custom text columns. Named filters match exactly; date filters search the original PDF date. Exports include every matching row and count totals linked to their markers.
register.author: Author
register.more_groups: More count groups are included in exports. Filter by a group to inspect it.
register.custom_help: Custom text fields: one KEY=VALUE per line, maximum 16. These are text values; formulas are not evaluated.
register.exported: Annotation register exported. The PDF is unchanged.

office.word_limits: Word reflows visible, unrotated, single-column text into 11 pt paragraphs. Original fonts, spacing, page breaks, semantic tables and graphics are not reconstructed. Complex pages, forms, clipping and bidirectional text are refused.
office.excel_limits: Excel maps visible text objects into rows and inferred columns, one sheet per PDF page. Every value is a literal string. Formulas, number types, merged cells, original styling and semantic tables are not reconstructed. Ambiguous or complex pages are refused.
office.powerpoint_limits: PowerPoint contains one 150 dpi PNG per PDF page. Text, tables and vectors are not editable. Mixed page sizes are fitted with margins. Maximum 8 million pixels per page.
office.export_limits: Exports support 1–128 pages and packages up to 128 MiB. Copy restrictions apply. Only PowerPoint preserves the visible page as an image; Word and Excel cannot guarantee the original layout. PDF signatures and encryption are not retained.
office.detected: Installed LibreOffice detected. Version 26.2 or 26.8 is checked before conversion.
office.unavailable: Local conversion is unavailable. Install a supported LibreOffice 26.2 or 26.8 separately, then reopen this dialog. SuniPDF does not download or install converters.
office.import_limits: Local, isolated processing: 1–128 macro-free DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/ODT/ODS/ODP files, 64 MiB per input, 120 seconds per conversion, 256 MiB per PDF. Macros, formulas, active fields, external links and embedded objects are refused. Unsupported fonts or layout may differ; review each result.
office.profile_limits: Standard: JPEG quality 90, images reduced to 150 dpi. Print: lossless images with no reduction. The selected profile is saved. Neither profile claims PDF/A or PDF/UA compliance.
rich.title: Rich annotations
rich.note: Preview the actual PDF appearance before applying. Every change is one Undo step. Coordinates are displayed page points.
rich.image_stamp_note: Fits the image inside the rectangle, preserving its proportions and transparency. Preview before applying. The copy is embedded in the PDF; this is not a digital signature.
rich.points: One x,y point per line (displayed page coordinates).
rich.eraser_note: Removes whole strokes touched by the brush path, preserving the others and the comment thread. Hit testing allows 0.1 pt tolerance. To remove all strokes and replies, use Delete annotation explicitly.
rich.font_note: Uses the selected PDF font and its real glyph metrics. Choose a CJK font for Chinese or Japanese. For installed fonts, choose the actual bold or italic face. Spaces are normalized when wrapping; unsupported glyphs and text that does not fit are refused.
rich.open_font: Embedded fonts, bold, italic and CJK…
rich.replace_selected: Replace the selected FreeText using this explicit font choice
rich.attachment_note: Embeds a copy up to 16 MiB. Only the filename is stored; no file is launched. Save a new PDF copy to share the attachment.
rich.file_error: Choose a readable local file up to 16 MiB with a valid filename.
rich.select_ink: Select an unlocked SuniPDF ink annotation first.
rich.stale: The document changed. Cancel and reopen the editor; your draft remains available here.
rich.finish_first: Apply or cancel the rich annotation draft first.
bookmarks.edit_limits: Up to 4,096 bookmarks, 32 levels and 1,024 UTF-8 bytes per title. Changes support Undo. Renaming preserves existing actions; setting a destination replaces the selected action.
security.redact.overlay.note: Printable Latin text, up to 256 characters. It must fit every rectangle. Added only after removal is verified. Clear it before saving unapplied marks.
security.redact.preview.running: Preparing and verifying all marked pages…
security.redact.preview.report: {native} selectable glyphs preserved; {bitmap} objects use pixel fallback.
security.redact.preview.fallback: Unsupported text, OCR, images and nested objects retain their visible remainder as pixels. Outside text within those objects may no longer be selectable.
security.redact.preview.stale: The document changed. Preview again before applying.
security.redact.preview.failed: Application failed. Your marks and settings were kept; preview again.
protect.current_owner.title: Authorize Protection Changes
protect.current_owner.subtitle: The current owner password is required before replacing document protection.
protect.current_owner.hint: Enter the current owner password. Existing protection stays in place until the replacement succeeds.
error.certificate_source_changed: The file on disk changed or is unavailable. Reload it before signing or verifying signatures.
security.redact.confirm.keep_warning: Cleanup is off. Metadata, accessibility text, bookmarks, destinations, attachments, scripts and XFA data may retain sensitive content outside the marked regions. Keep this data only if you have checked it separately.
certificate.status.weak_digest: Signature rejected: weak or unsupported digest algorithm.
certificate.summary.failed: Verification failed for one or more signatures.
certificate.summary.trusted: Signature integrity and signer identity verified.
certificate.summary.integrity_only: Signature integrity verified; signer identity is not fully trusted.
certificate.declared_by_signer: Declared by the signer — not a verification result
review.saved_files: Read-only analysis of selected saved files. Save current edits first. Nothing is uploaded; no folder is crawled and no index is saved.
review.limits: Up to 64 files, 64 MiB per file and 250,000 extracted characters per page. Protected files are reported separately. Search: 10,000 pages / 2,000 matching pages per run.
review.compare_limits: Align physical pages from these starting pages; inserted pages are not detected automatically. Preview: 768 pixels, channel tolerance 16/255. No OCR, semantic comparison, signature, hidden-data or conformance validation. No observed difference does not prove identical PDFs.
review.partial: Partial results — cancelled, limited or failed inputs remain unanalysed
review.no_matches: No matches in the analysed text. Image-only pages require OCR first.
review.comparison_summary: {scanned}/{total} aligned page pairs analysed; {changed} pairs have observed differences.
review.geometry_changed: Page size or page presence differs
review.no_text: Some page pairs have no extractable text. Only their preview and page geometry can be compared; OCR is not automatic.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.scope: Choose a command, then assign a Ctrl shortcut. Escape cancels; Save applies all changes. Navigation, clipboard and system keys remain reserved.
shortcuts.syntax: Use Ctrl, optional Shift, and one letter, digit, F2–F12, Tab, Delete, Plus, Equals, Minus, OpenBracket or CloseBracket.
shortcuts.reserved: This shortcut is reserved for text editing or Windows.
shortcuts.invalid: Invalid stored shortcuts. Restore defaults before saving; the app currently uses defaults.
shortcuts.save_failed: Preferences could not be saved. Your active shortcuts have not changed.
watermark.image_scope: Foreground image, fitted inside the margins. Existing transparency is retained. Undo removes the whole batch.
headers.title: Headers and footers
headers.scope: Six single-line zones, one third of page width each. Overflow is refused. One Undo removes the entire operation.
presets.scope: Local presets: 16 maximum. Save/delete updates preferences; choosing only loads a draft. Image presets reference the original file.
presets.name: New preset name
hub.measure.name: Measurements
hub.measure.desc: Calibrate a scale, then measure lengths, areas and angles on the page.
measure.calibration_hint: Click two points on a known distance, then enter its real length.
measure.distance_hint: Enter the real distance between the two points, then confirm the scale.
measure.draw_hint: Click points on the page. Enter or double-click to preview; Backspace removes a point. Hold Shift to align. Escape cancels.
measure.no_scale: Calibrate this page before measuring lengths or areas.
measure.finish_first: Finish or cancel the measurement before changing the document or tool.
measure.page_scope: The scale applies to this page. Save it in the PDF to reuse it after reopening. Existing measurements keep their own scale.
measure.saved.changed: Page scale updated. Save the PDF to keep this change.
measure.saved.restricted: This PDF does not allow page metadata changes. Session calibration and permitted annotations remain available.
measure.saved.help: Values come from saved annotation inputs. Check the page-reference status before reusing a value or scale.
measure.saved.empty: No supported measurements on this page.
measure.saved.use_unavailable: Only measurements bound to the current page can supply a scale. Angles have no physical scale; calibration points must be inside the page.
measure.validity.historical: Historical value only. It is excluded from usable quantities and costs until explicitly recalibrated.
measure.validity.geometry_blocked: Recalibrate this measurement against the current page before editing its geometry.
measure.validity.recreate_angle: Review the points and recreate this angle on the current page. Unit or precision changes cannot verify it.
measure.validity.recalibrate_help: Check every measurement point against the current drawing, then explicitly use a current page reference and review the preview before applying.
measure.validity.reference_required: Close this editor, calibrate a known distance on the current page, then reopen the measurement. A saved historical scale is not sufficient.
measure.validity.reference_selected: Current page reference selected. Preview and Apply will recalculate the retained points; the original value remains historical until Apply.
measure.validity.batch_warning: This selection includes historical measurements. Check their points and use an explicit current reference before recalculating. Historical angles remain excluded and must be recreated.
measure.saved.finish_first: Close the measurement inspector or wait for the scale update before changing the document.
measure.same_page: Finish or cancel the current drawing before measuring another page.
measure.angle_hint: Click the first arm, the vertex, then the second arm.
measure.point_limit: A measurement can contain at most 128 points.
measure.scale_invalid: Enter a finite positive distance and use two different points.
measure.ready_hint: Choose a measurement type, then draw directly on the page.
measure.stale: The document changed. Recalibrate the page before measuring.
measure.title: Calibrated measurements
measure.note: Each annotation keeps its own calibration. Enter displayed-page points (bottom-left origin); preview before applying. Use decimal feet or inches. To change geometry or scale, recreate the measurement.
measure.calibration: Calibration: two points spanning the known distance
measure.invalid: Complete a positive calibration and valid measurement geometry.
measure.angle: Angle (three points; vertex in the middle)
measure.saved.reset_hint: Discard only the temporary scale for this page. The PDF and saved measurements stay unchanged.
measure.edit.title: Edit saved measurement
measure.edit.help: Change this measurement only. Preview the result before applying; page scales and other measurements stay unchanged.
measure.edit.reference: Reference points on this page (PDF points, bottom-left origin):
measure.edit.geometry: The measurement points stay unchanged. Changing the unit converts the reference distance; changing the reference distance recalculates this measurement.
library.title: Annotation library
library.description: Save, import and place reusable local annotation templates.
library.finish_first: Finish or cancel the library action first.
library.empty: Your library is empty. Create a rich annotation draft, then choose Save to library.
library.save_help: Save this draft as a reusable template. The PDF stays unchanged.
library.unsupported: Only new text with a built-in font, shapes, stamps and image drafts can be saved.
library.name: Name
library.delete_help: Remove selected templates from this local library? PDF annotations already placed remain unchanged.
library.group_help: Combine selected templates at explicit offsets; sources remain in the library.
library.place_help: Click a page to set the lower-left origin, then inspect Preview and Apply.
library.preview_help: Origin and scale use the displayed page axes. Applying creates new independent annotations.
library.bounds: Keep the complete template inside the page.
library.no_document: Open a PDF to create or place a template.
library.stale: The document changed. Choose the template again.
library.storage_unavailable: The local library folder is unavailable.
library.changed_on_disk: The library changed on disk. Reload it before saving.
library.owned_only: Templates store their own images and supported styles. Measurements, scales, replies and document identities are excluded.
library.provenance_help: Optional declarations; blank means unknown. Reuse permissions are not verified automatically.
overlay.title: Revision overlay
overlay.description: Align two saved plan pages and compare them in distinct colors.
overlay.saved_files: Choose two saved PDF files. Unsaved changes in open tabs are not included; neither source is modified.
overlay.limits: One page from each file, up to 64 MiB per PDF. This is a raster overlay, not an automatic or vector comparison.
overlay.points_hint: Preview to load the pages. Click point 1 then point 2 on the base, then the corresponding points in the same order on the revision. Preview again to align. Reset clears all four points.
overlay.coordinates: Offsets use displayed PDF points from the top-left corner: right and down are positive. Scale and rotation are applied to the revision first, then the offset.
overlay.refresh_hint: The settings have changed. Preview again before exporting.
overlay.sources_changed: A source file changed. Alignment and selected points were reset. Preview again to load the current pages before aligning or exporting.
overlay.canvas: {width} × {height} pixels. The base page defines the canvas; revision content outside it is clipped. Enlarging a small source image does not recover fine detail.
overlay.fingerprint_hint: Exports recheck both saved files against these fingerprints. A changed source requires a new preview. Fingerprints identify file bytes, not the accuracy of the alignment.
overlay.load_hint: Choose the files and pages, then Preview. For two-point alignment, use the two source images that appear.
quantity.title: Quantity table
quantity.help: Quantities from saved annotations, typed fields and explicit unit prices.
quantity.number_unit_help: A named column must use the same type and unit throughout the PDF. Changing the declared unit does not convert the value.
quantity.unit_type_change: Select No unit explicitly before changing the field type.
quantity.edit_help: Blank price means no price. Zero is a supplied price. Prices use decimal notation; no formulas.
quantity.more_columns: Showing up to 16 custom columns. Filter names to find other columns.
quantity.no_export: Copying permission is required to export.
quantity.partial: Partial subtotal: some rows have no quantity or compatible price.
quantity.stale: The document changed. Refresh the table before applying edits.
quantity.finish_first: Finish or cancel the quantity-table edit first.
quantity.readonly: This row cannot be edited with the current document permissions or annotation state.
quantity.blank_custom: Remove a custom column to leave it absent. An empty text value remains supplied.
measure.geometry.hint: Select or drag a vertex, then preview the change. Use the numbered selector for overlapping vertices. Escape cancels without changing the PDF.
measure.geometry.preserved: The original calibration, reference distance, unit, precision and measurement type are preserved.
measure.geometry.add_hint: Click the interior of a segment to add one vertex, then drag the new handle if needed. Zoom in when edges or vertices overlap.
measure.geometry.insert_refused: Choose a clear segment, away from its endpoints and other edges. No vertex was added.
measure.geometry.remove_refused: Removing this vertex would create invalid geometry. Move it or choose another vertex. Nothing was removed.
measure.geometry.fixed_count: Length keeps two vertices; angle keeps three. Their vertices can be moved but not added or removed.
measure.finish_draft_first: Finish or cancel the measurement before switching panels.
updates.linux_install: Download the Ubuntu .deb from the release page, then install it with your package manager.
platform.windows_only: This feature is currently available on Windows only.
platform.signature_session_only: Signatures can be drawn or imported for this session. The encrypted signature library is available on Windows only.
measure.snap.title: Precision
measure.snap.help: Move within 8 pixels of a vector endpoint or intersection. Scanned pixels are not snap targets.
measure.snap.empty: No eligible vectors on this page.
measure.snap.clipped: Unsupported clipped paths are omitted from snapping.
measure.snap.unavailable: Vector snapping unavailable for this page.
measure.viewport.title: Scale regions
measure.viewport.help: Select an overlapping region explicitly. Geometry must stay inside the chosen region.
measure.viewport.draw: Click two opposite corners on this page, name the region, then save it.
measure.viewport.name: Region name
measure.viewport.update_scale: Use temporary scale for this region
measure.viewport.existing_unchanged: Changing a region affects future measurements. Existing measurements retain their own scale.
measure.viewport.remove_help: Remove this scale region from the PDF? Existing measurements keep their values. The change can be undone.
measure.viewport.reference_inside: Both calibration reference points must be inside the region.
measure.viewport.conflict: Choose the correct region or the page scale before drawing. A measurement cannot cross its selected region boundary.
measure.viewport.unavailable: The scale regions could not be read. Refresh this page before measuring.
measure.batch.help: Apply the active calibration to a page range. Preview all affected measurement values before changing the PDF.
measure.batch.recalculate: Recalculate all saved length and area measurements on these pages
measure.batch.regions_unchanged: Page defaults are replaced. Region definitions remain unchanged; angles are excluded.
measure.batch.limit: Select at most 512 pages per operation.
measure.batch.confirm_help: Review old → new values below. Apply commits the entire operation; Undo restores it in one step.
measure.batch.applied: Scale changes applied. Undo is available.
find.title: Find in document
measure.viewport.reset_help: The saved scale regions no longer match this page. Clear those region definitions? Existing measurement values are preserved. This change can be undone.
quantity.formula_help: Report-only arithmetic: decimals, + - * /, parentheses, quantity and [Numeric field]. Fields keep their declared unit; each and deg are not dimensionless. The selected unit constrains source quantity, not the result. Matching length families allow products and quotients up to volume, such as m*m=m2 and m3/m=m2. Mixed or inverse units and incompatible operations give an error; no mass/density units or implicit conversions. Each operation rounds half away from zero at six decimals. Configuration stays in this tab; copy it to reuse.
quantity.formula_partial: Partial formula subtotal: review the excluded errors.
quantity.formula_subtotal_help: Totals sum rounded row results separately by formula, group, unit and precision.
quantity.formula_config_help: Copy the JSON configuration, or paste an array of formula definitions and load it. The PDF is unchanged.
quantity.unverified_rows: {total} historical measurements excluded: {legacy} legacy, {stale} with changed page references.
quantity.unverified_help: Historical quantities and prices do not contribute to quantity or cost totals. Custom fields and stored prices can be corrected; explicit recalibration is required before using the quantity. Exports retain the warning and historical value.
library.capture_help: Select 1–16 native shapes, lines, polygons or clouds. Unsupported annotations are disabled. Declare the source; originals remain unchanged.
library.capture_save: Save selected annotations as a group
measure.rectangle.title: Dimensioned rectangle
measure.rectangle.place_hint: Click the lower-left corner. The rectangle extends right and up. Snapping affects only this anchor; Escape cancels.
measure.rectangle.preview_note: Dimensions and scale are retained in this preview. Cancel to change them. Apply creates a four-vertex area measurement; later vertex editing is ordinary polygon editing.
measure.rectangle.local_note: Use the most recently confirmed page reference. After changing document or page content, confirm the reference again. Preview checks that it still matches the current document.
measure.rectangle.invalid_dimensions: Enter positive, finite width and height in the selected unit.
measure.rectangle.confirm_reference: Confirm the scale on this page again before placing a dimensioned rectangle.
measure.rectangle.capture_failed: The temporary reference could not be captured: {reason}
plan_sets.title: Plan sets
plan_sets.existing_tab_warning: An open tab may contain a different revision or unsaved changes. Its sheet contents are not verified by the manifest check.
plan_sets.existing_page: Requested physical page: {page}. Opening the verified saved copy preserves the existing tab and its history.
plan_sets.existing_unavailable: The existing tab has a different page count or its saved identity does not match. Open the verified copy instead.
plan_sets.use_existing: Show this page in the unsaved tab
plan_sets.open_verified_copy: Open verified copy in a new tab
plan_sets.all_ready: All saved-file references passed the last check.
plan_sets.has_issues: Some references need attention. Review the file checks and sheet statuses.
plan_sets.quit_warning: Save a new manifest copy before quitting, or explicitly discard this draft. Unsaved PDF tabs will still use their own save prompt.
plan_sets.help: Keep sheet references and metadata in a local manifest. PDFs remain unchanged. Add PDFs from the chosen root folder or its subfolders.
plan_sets.password_unavailable: The password is missing or incorrect. Enter a one-use password and repeat the file operation; the manifest draft was retained.
plan_sets.password_help: A password is used only for the next PDF file operation and is cleared from this form when sent. It is never stored in the manifest. One operation uses the same password for its selected files.
plan_sets.use_password: Use a password for the next file operation
plan_sets.choose_root: Choose the folder containing the plan PDFs
plan_sets.name: Set name
plan_sets.unvalidated: References need validation. Opening a sheet always verifies its source again.
plan_sets.checked_snapshot: Statuses describe the last check of saved files, not unsaved PDF tabs. Validate again after external changes.
plan_sets.pending_fields: Apply or reset these edits before selecting another sheet, validating or saving.
plan_sets.refresh_warning: This replaces the selected file reference and fingerprint for all its sheets. Sheet metadata and physical page numbers are retained; confirm they still describe the chosen revision.
plan_sets.discard_warning: This set has unsaved changes. Save a new manifest copy to keep them, or explicitly discard them before replacing the set.
plan_sets.cancelled: Cancelled. The current manifest draft was retained.
plan_sets.fields_applied: Metadata applied to the draft. Save a new manifest copy to keep it.
plan_sets.saved: New manifest copy saved. Relative file references were rebased safely.
plan_sets.navigation_failed: The sheet could not be opened at its recorded page. The existing tabs and manifest draft were retained.
plan_sets.navigation_busy: Finish the current document operation before opening this sheet.
plan_sets.opened_dirty: Showing the existing tab with unsaved changes. Its physical pages may differ from the saved plan reference.
plan_sets.opened: Sheet opened in its document tab.
measure.volume.depth_hint: Physical depth is independent of the drawing scale and area unit.
measure.deductions.hint: Draw at least three points per contour. Select a contour to add or undo its points. Deductions must stay strictly inside the outer contour without touching or overlapping.
measure.deductions.invalid: Complete each contour with at least three distinct points. Contours must not cross or touch; deductions must stay inside without overlap.
measure.deductions.limit: Maximum: 16 deductions, 128 points per contour, 512 points in total.
plan_links.title: Plan links
plan_links.help: Link exact sheet references in saved PDF text. Choose indexed destinations, review each match, preview both pages, then save a new copy.
plan_links.password_help: Passwords are used only for this operation and cleared when you close or cancel.
plan_links.remote_help: Open this saved destination only after checking it against the selected manifest. Unsaved changes in an existing tab are preserved.
plan_links.saved_only: Use saved files only; unsaved tab edits are not included.
plan_links.partial: Some references or pages need attention. Only explicitly approved, verified matches can be included.
plan_links.no_matches: No exact references were found. Image-only pages need a searchable text layer first.
plan_links.saving: Saving a new copy. Wait for the final result.
plan_links.invalid_selection: Choose a source, destination sheets and up to 32 distinct page numbers separated by commas.
plan_links.status.geometry: Text geometry cannot be linked safely
plan_links.status.same_document: Destination is in the source PDF
plan_links.status.pages: Page count or page selection changed
plan_sets.filter_hint: Sheet number, title, discipline, revision or file
plan_sets.hidden_selection: The selected sheet is hidden by this filter. Reset the view before opening it.
plan_sets.sort_help: Select a column heading to sort. Revision labels are not a chronological order.
transfer.title: Transfer revision annotations
transfer.saved_files: Choose the saved old and new PDFs. Save creates a new copy of the complete new PDF; both sources remain unchanged.
transfer.limits: Supported native shapes only. Measurements, quantities, prices, forms, replies, review states and arbitrary appearances are excluded. Maximum 32 page pairs, 16 selections per page and 256 in total. Repeated transfers can create duplicates.
transfer.password_hint: Optional passwords are used for the next operation only and never saved. Re-enter them for a protected preview; only the new PDF password is needed to display another candidate page.
transfer.suggest: Suggest matches by discipline and sheet number
transfer.suggestion_limit: No unique matches, or more than 32 matches. Choose page pairs explicitly; ambiguous and unmatched sheets are not assigned automatically.
transfer.suggested: {count} unique page pairs suggested; {excluded} unmatched or ambiguous sheets excluded. Review each pair. Revision labels do not determine chronology.
transfer.manual_help: These sheets cannot be transferred through an automatic match. Select a page pair below, then assign one side explicitly and verify its counterpart, alignment and annotations before previewing.
transfer.match_unmatched: Not assigned: no matching discipline and sheet number, or the sheet number is empty.
transfer.match_ambiguous: Not assigned: more than one sheet has the same discipline and sheet number.
transfer.annotations: Annotations on the selected old page
transfer.no_annotations: This page contains no annotations. It can remain mapped without a selection.
transfer.coordinates: Displayed PDF points from the top-left, x right and y down. Uniform scale 0.01–100 and quarter-turn rotations only; other rotations are refused.
transfer.confirm_pair: I confirm this page pair and its alignment
transfer.repeat_ack: I acknowledge that a repeated transfer may create duplicate annotations
transfer.reviewed: I have reviewed this candidate page
transfer.review_all: Preview and review every mapped new page before saving. Changing a selection or mapping invalidates all previews.
transfer.dirty_source: A selected PDF has unsaved changes in an open tab. Save it or choose another source, then inspect and preview again.
transfer.working: Validating revisions and preparing the transfer…
outlines.title: Revision outlines
outlines.limits: Compare one saved page pair. Raster differences include annotations and forms; they are proposals, not confirmed geometric changes. Select and classify regions before creating a new annotated PDF copy.
outlines.saved_ack: Use the saved files; unsaved tab changes are excluded
outlines.partial: Partial inspection or review: some pixels or regions remain outside this result.
outlines.coverage: Unmapped: new {new}, old {old} pixels · filtered {filtered} pixels · omitted {omitted} regions
outlines.none: No region was proposed at these settings. Check the coverage and filtering totals.
outlines.edge: Cloud cannot fit precisely inside this page
outlines.summary: {created} outlines · {noise} noise decisions · {excluded} regions not reviewed
outlines.no_output: No PDF output: these decisions create no outlines.
outlines.coordinates: Alignment maps OLD to NEW. Coordinates are displayed points from the TOP LEFT; y increases downwards.
outlines.reviewed: I have reviewed this actual annotated page before saving
issue_report.title: Issue and quantity reports
issue_report.help: Prepare a report from this document and the current table selection. Review the pages, then export a new file.
issue_report.incomplete: Coverage is incomplete. Unresolved locations, historical measurements and formula errors are retained in the report; missing totals are not zero.
issue_report.clear_export: This report will be unencrypted. It can contain sensitive source information. Your source PDF keeps its encryption and permissions.
issue_report.signatures: Source signatures are not transferred to this new report. The signed PDF is unchanged.
issue_report.saved_source: Based on the verified saved source. The source must remain unchanged until export.
issue_report.snapshot_source: Based on the current document, including unsaved changes. This does not save or modify the source PDF.
issue_report.reviewed: I have reviewed the report and its coverage before exporting
quantity_workbook.title: Quantity workbooks
quantity_workbook.help: Review quantities and changes before exporting a new spreadsheet. Keep the refresh data to compare a later PDF revision.
quantity_workbook.baseline_help: The imported baseline supplies the original selection and formulas. Its history is not authenticated; verify its source. Changes are recalculated from this PDF.
quantity_workbook.reviewed: I have reviewed the values, changes and incomplete coverage before exporting
quantity_workbook.manifest_help: Export refresh data separately and keep it with the spreadsheet for the next revision. Each export creates a new file.
quantity_workbook.incomplete: Coverage is incomplete. Review missing or ambiguous identities, unverified quantities and calculation errors. Missing values are not zero.
quantity_workbook.clear_export: The spreadsheet and refresh data will be unencrypted and may contain sensitive information. The source PDF keeps its protection.
quantity_workbook.signatures: Source signatures are not transferred to these new files. The signed PDF is unchanged.
plan_links.batch.title: Link multiple plan PDFs
plan_links.batch.help: Choose saved source PDFs and explicit destinations for each one. Review every reference, then save new linked copies beside their originals.
plan_links.batch.limits: Up to 16 sources, 32 pages per source, 128 pages and 4,096 references per batch. Destinations remain the original PDFs.
plan_links.batch.excluded_file: No approved references: this source is excluded from publication.
plan_links.batch.preview_help: Previews are regenerated from verified originals. Saving checks all inputs again and commits one new copy at a time.
plan_links.batch.saving: Saving new copies. Completed files remain available if a later file fails or you cancel.
plan_links.batch.receipt_help: Saved copies are listed below. They are not rolled back. Review the remaining files explicitly before retrying; existing files cannot be overwritten.
plan_links.batch.inputs_valid: Inputs matched at the last identity check.
plan_links.batch.inputs_changed: An input changed. Previously saved copies remain listed.
